name: csv_reconcile_returns
title: CSV Reconcile Returns
prompt: Per README.md: net(sku) = sum(qty*unit_price over all orders rows) minus sum(refund amounts). Do not skip order rows or forget refunds. Submit the top sku as: SKU-XX N.NN

README.md: net(sku) = sum(qty*unit_price in orders) - sum(amount in refunds).
Use FILES['orders.csv'] / FILES['refunds.csv'] with gmatch. Lua has no string.split.
Submit the top sku and net, e.g. SKU-09 12.34 — never the placeholder text SKU-XX.
